service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , SMR_NUMBER , SMD_NUMBER , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , SEAL_TYPE , SEAL_MG_DEPT , SUBJECT , COUNT , PRINT_COUNT , DOWN_COUNT , AUTO_PRINT_FLAG , PUBLISH_NO , REAL_ATTACH_NO , ITEMS_JSON , MARK_COUNT , RE_DETAIL FROM SSIPD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SMR_NUMBER = ${SMR_NUMBER} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

UPDATE SSCGL SET CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE} , CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME} , CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} , CONT_TYPE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_TYPE}, CONT_TYPE) , CONT_SUBJECT = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_SUBJECT}, CONT_SUBJECT) , STATUS = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${STATUS}, STATUS) , CATEGORY = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CATEGORY}, CATEGORY) , CONT_METHOD = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_METHOD}, CONT_METHOD) , CONT_FORM_NO = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_FORM_NO}, CONT_FORM_NO) , CONT_DATE = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_DATE}, CONT_DATE) , CONT_FROM = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_FROM}, CONT_FROM) , CONT_TO = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_TO}, CONT_TO) , EXPIRED_ALARM = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${EXPIRED_ALARM}, EXPIRED_ALARM) , SUMMARY = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SUMMARY}, SUMMARY) , CONT_AMT = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${CONT_AMT}, CONT_AMT) , SIGN_ORDER = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SIGN_ORDER}, SIGN_ORDER) , SOURCE_NO = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${SOURCE_NO}, SOURCE_NO) , REMARK = #DB_OWNER#nvl(${REMARK}, REMARK) WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${CONT_NO} AND CONT_GL_SEQ = ${CONT_GL_SEQ}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , CONT_NO , CONT_GL_SEQ , SIGNER_ID , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , DEL_FLAG , SEQ , SIGNER_COMPANY_CODE , FIXED_SIGNER_NAME , FIXED_SIGNER_EMAIL , FIXED_SIGNER_PHONE , FIXED_IRS_NO , FIXED_CATEGORY FROM SSCSI WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${CONT_NO} AND CONT_GL_SEQ = ${CONT_GL_SEQ} AND SIGNER_ID = $S{SIGNER_ID} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT FMFI.HOUSE_CODE , FMFI.COMPANY_CODE , FMFI.DOC_NUMBER , FMFI.FILE_ID , FMMT.VALUE AS FIX_HTML FROM SFMFI FMFI INNER JOIN SFMMT FMMT ON FMMT.HOUSE_CODE = FMFI.HOUSE_CODE AND FMMT.COMPANY_CODE = FMFI.COMPANY_CODE AND FMMT.ID = FMFI.FILE_ID AND FMMT.KEY = 'FIX_HTML' WHERE FMFI.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND FMFI.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND FMFI.DOC_NUMBER = ${CONT_FORM_NO}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , DOC_NUMBER , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , POSTPROCESSED , POSTPROCESSED_RESULT , ATTACH_NUMBER , CHANGE_USER_ID , PRC_TYPE , DATA FROM SMCWT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DOC_NUMBER = ${DOC_NUMBER}
SELECT * FROM SSIGN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CONT_NO = ${CONT_NO}

SELECT BUPR.HOUSE_CODE , BUPR.BIZ_CODE , BUPR.BIZ_CATEGORY , BUPR.BIZ_TYPE , BUPR.SELLER_NAME_LOC , BUPR.IRS_NO , BUPR.CEO_NAME_LOC , BUPI.SEQ , BUPI.USER_ID , BUPI.USER_NAME , BUPI.EMAIL , BUPI.PHONE_NO , BUPI.IF_FLAG FROM SBUPR BUPR INNER JOIN SBUPI BUPI ON BUPR.HOUSE_CODE = BUPI.HOUSE_CODE AND BUPR.BIZ_CODE = BUPI.BIZ_CODE WHERE BUPR.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BUPR.SELLER_NAME_LOC = ${SELLER_NAME_LOC} AND BUPR.IRS_NO = ${IRS_NO} AND BUPR.BIZ_CODE = $S{BIZ_CODE} AND BUPI.USER_ID = $S{USER_ID} AND BUPI.USER_NAME = $S{USER_NAME}

SELECT BUPR.HOUSE_CODE , BUPR.BIZ_CODE , BUPR.BIZ_CATEGORY , BUPR.BIZ_TYPE , BUPR.SELLER_NAME_LOC , BUPI.USER_ID , BUPI.USER_NAME , BUPI.EMAIL , BUPI.PHONE_NO , BUPI.IF_FLAG FROM SBUPR BUPR INNER JOIN SBUPI BUPI ON BUPR.HOUSE_CODE = BUPI.HOUSE_CODE AND BUPR.BIZ_CODE = BUPI.BIZ_CODE WHERE BUPR.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BUPR.BIZ_CATEGORY = ${CATEGORY} AND BUPI.USER_ID = ${SIGNER_ID} AND BUPI.USER_NAME = ${SIGNER_NAME}
